children: Glucotrack entered a series of agreements to complete a registered direct offering expected to raise approximately $3.1 million. The Securities Purchase Agreement covers 169,388 shares and pre-funded warrants to purchase up to 1,350,220 shares at $2.04 per share (warrants priced at $2.039 with a $0.001 exercise price), with proceeds earmarked to repay debt and for working capital. Dawson James Securities served as placement agent for an 8% cash fee on gross proceeds. Directors and executive officers agreed to 90-day lock-ups, while the purchase agreement includes six-month restrictions on new issuances and variable-rate transactions.
